data.description: South Bay: Poised to Thrive as the Premier Choice for Investors and Homebuyers Alike

data.answer: South Bay is located in The Residential District of Dubai South. The focal point of the South Bay master plan is a one-kilometer lagoon, which offers over three kilometers of waterfront promenade. Once completed, it will be an exclusive gated community. Carefully designed around what is set to become the world's largest airport, Dubai South is an inclusive and unified community fostered by smart and sustainable surroundings.

South Bay Dubai South’s master plan includes over 800 villas and townhouses, with more than 200 waterfront mansions. The townhouses and semi-detached villas in the area comprise 3 to 5 bedrooms, while the standalone waterfront villas consist of 5 to 7 bedrooms. The covered area of these properties ranges from approximately 2,900 sq. ft. to 4,800 sq. ft., and they will offer stunning views of the lagoon. The five clusters with more than 1200 units will offer residents a luxurious lifestyle.

Properties for Sale in South Bay

There are various off-plan projects in South Bay available for sale. You can buy a 3-bedroom villa in South Bay for AED 1.8M. For a 4-bedroom villa, you might pay at least AED 2.4M. 5-bedroom villas in South Bay are priced from AED 3.1M, while the 6-bedroom villa is available for a minimum purchase price of AED 9.4M.

The sales price for 3-bedroom townhouses in South Bay starts from AED 1.9M, while 4-bedroom townhouses are available from AED 2.6 M. 5-bedroom off-plan townhouses in South Bay are available at a minimum price of AED 2.9M. Thanks to its strategic location and competitive pricing, the sub-district has emerged as a promising hotspot for investors.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in South Bay?

data.answer:
Life in South Bay offers a blend of luxury living and community-centric amenities. Residents enjoy a tranquil environment with access to waterfront views and lush surroundings. The area boasts a range of housing options, from villas to townhouses, catering to diverse lifestyles. With a well-designed infrastructure and proximity to key facilities, South Bay fosters convenience and comfort. Additionally, its strategic location within Dubai South provides opportunities for growth and development, making it an attractive choice for residents seeking a balanced and vibrant lifestyle.

Public Transportation in South Bay

Public transportation in the South Bay area of Dubai primarily relies on the Dubai Metro and bus services. The community has a public bus route connecting to the Expo 2020 Metro station.

Supermarkets in South Bay

In South Bay, residents have access to various supermarkets catering to their everyday needs. Popular options include:

  • Carrefour Market
  • Spinneys
  • Choithrams

These supermarkets offer a wide range of groceries, fresh produce, household items, and more, ensuring convenience for residents within South Bay.

Shopping Malls near South Bay

Within a short driving distance from South Bay, residents have access to several prominent shopping destinations. Ibn Battuta Mall, located approximately 15 minutes away, offers a diverse range of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities. Dubai Marina Mall, also around 15 minutes away, provides a waterfront shopping experience with upscale boutiques and waterfront dining. Additionally, The Outlet Village, roughly a 20-minute drive, offers discounted luxury brands and a unique shopping atmosphere.

Schools Near South Bay

South Bay residents have convenient access to reputable educational institutions within proximity. Jebel Ali School, located approximately 10 minutes away, offers a British curriculum and excellent academic programs. Victory Heights Primary School, also around 10 minutes away, provides a holistic approach to education within a vibrant community. GEMS United School, situated about 15 minutes away, offers an international curriculum and modern facilities to support student learning.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near South Bay Area 

Residents of South Bay have access to various places of worship within a short driving distance. St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, located approximately 10 minutes away in Jebel Ali Village, provides spiritual services to the Catholic community. For Hindu residents, the Shiva Temple in Bur Dubai is approximately a 25-minute drive away. Masjid Al Salam Mosque in Jebel Ali Village, around 10 minutes away, serves as a place of worship for Muslim residents.

Clinics and Hospitals in South Bay Dubai

South Bay residents benefit from access to quality healthcare facilities within the vicinity. Aster Clinic in Jebel Ali Village, approximately 10 minutes away, offers primary healthcare services and specialist consultations. Mediclinic Parkview Hospital in Dubai South, around 15 minutes away, provides comprehensive medical care, including emergency services and specialized treatments. Emirates Hospital Day Surgery & Medical Centre in Dubai Investment Park, approximately 20 minutes away, offers outpatient services and diagnostic facilities to cater to the healthcare needs of residents.

South Bay Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

The newly launched Dubai South community is located along Expo Road (E77) and provides easy access to Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. Expo City and Emaar South, also part of the Dubai South community, are about 15 minutes away from South Bay.

more_info.question: Things to Do in South Bay

data.answer:
In South Bay, residents can immerse themselves in a vibrant lifestyle with an array of activities to enjoy. From strolls along the waterfront promenade to indulging in culinary delights at nearby restaurants, there's something for everyone. Outdoor enthusiasts can explore the picturesque parks and green spaces.

Restaurants In and Near South Bay Dubai

South Bay residents enjoy a diverse culinary scene with a variety of restaurants in the vicinity. Within South Bay itself, residents can find dining options ranging from casual cafes to upscale eateries offering international cuisines. Additionally, nearby areas such as Jebel Ali Village and Dubai Marina host a plethora of restaurants catering to different tastes and preferences. Residents can indulge in delicious meals without having to venture too far from home.

Beaches Near South Bay

For those seeking a day of relaxation by the sea, South Bay offers easy access to beautiful beaches along the Dubai coastline. JBR Beach, approximately a 20-minute drive away, boasts pristine sands and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf. Kite Beach, also around 20 minutes away, is popular among water sports enthusiasts and offers a vibrant beachfront atmosphere with various food stalls and recreational activities.

Attractions and Landmarks Near South Bay

South Bay Dubai is just an 11-minute drive away from Al Maktoum International Airport, the future largest airport in the world. This strategic location provides residents with easy access to global travel opportunities and reflects the area's connectivity to major transportation hubs.

South Bay residents are within reach of several attractions and landmarks that showcase Dubai's rich culture and modern developments. The Expo 2020 site, located just minutes away, offers a glimpse into the future with innovative pavilions and exhibitions. Dubai Parks and Resorts, approximately a 20-minute drive, is a major entertainment destination featuring theme parks and attractions for all ages. Additionally, residents can explore the Dubai Marina area, known for its iconic skyline, waterfront promenades, and leisure activities.

One potential disadvantage of living in South Bay could be its proximity to construction sites and ongoing development projects within Dubai South. While these projects signify growth and progress for the area, they may also bring about noise, dust, and occasional disruptions to daily life. Additionally, as South Bay continues to develop, there might be periods of increased traffic congestion or limited access

What is the South Bay Dubai location?

South Bay is situated within the Residential District of Dubai South, centrally located adjacent to Expo Road (E77).

What kind of properties are available in South Bay Dubai?

South Bay offers a variety of residential options including 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas and townhouses, as well as 5, 6, and 7-bedroom mansions.

data.content:
South Bay is an upcoming community in Dubai South, which consists of townhouses, villas, and mansions. South Bay is strategically located next to Expo Road (E77), making commutes to and from the community easier for residents.

It has a crystal lagoon, water promenades, and beaches. Other amenities include a lake park, swimming pools, a clubhouse, cafes and a shopping mall.

Dubai South Properties has developed South Bay in six phases, with the first phase commencing in 2022. Ginco General Contracting was awarded the contract for the initial phases, while Al Kharafi Construction Company will manage the other phases of the waterfront district.
